text.바스티온 사이클은 세계 최초의 하이퍼 바이크 제조사로, 세상에서 가장 매: Bastion Cycles is the world's first hyper bike manufacturer, building the most desirable bicycles in the world. Each bike is made to order in Melbourne, Australia, from 3D-printed titanium lugs and filament-wound carbon tubes.
text.바스티온,사이클,코리아,Bastion,Cycles,바스티온 아키타입,슈퍼: Bastion,Bastion Cycles,Bastion Cycles Korea,Bastion Archetype,Superleggera,Crossroad,Panterra,ArchAngel,titanium lugs,Rubi Workshop,Seoul
text.세계 최초의 하이퍼 바이크 제조사, 바스티온 사이클. 3D 프린팅 티타늄: Bastion Cycles, the world's first hyper bike manufacturer. Bespoke bikes built from 3D-printed titanium lugs and carbon tubes.
text.세계 최초의 하이퍼 바이크 제조사: The world's first hyper bike manufacturer
text.바스티온 판테라 그래블 라이딩: Riding the Bastion Panterra on gravel
text.아키타입의 DNA, 새로운 그래블 플랫폼: Archetype DNA on a new gravel platform
text.전 세계 88대 한정, 바스티온 아크엔젤: Bastion ArchAngel, limited to 88 units worldwide
text.바스티온 사이클은 세계 최초의 하이퍼 바이크 제조사입니다. 2014년 호: Bastion Cycles is the world's first hyper bike manufacturer. It was founded in Melbourne, Australia, in 2014 by Benjamin Schultz and James Woolcock, both former leaders in automotive design and engineering. They brought the precision of sports car engineering to the bicycle, and build each bespoke bike one at a time to its rider's specification.
text.바스티온 공동 창립자 벤자민 슐츠와 제임스 울코크: Bastion co-founders Benjamin Schultz and James Woolcock
text.벤은 최고 경험 책임자(CXO)로서 제품과 브랜드의 모든 접점을 큐레이팅: As Chief Experience Officer (CXO), Ben curates every point of contact with the product and the brand. As Chief Technology Officer (CTO), James refines every stage of design and production. The two moved from cars to bicycles to redefine what a bicycle can be.
text.독특하고 시대를 초월하는 디자인 미학을 통해 바스티온은 빠르게 전 세계에: With a distinctive, timeless design language, Bastion quickly became a design icon recognized around the world. It redefines the relationship between rider and bicycle, and carries Australia's design and manufacturing heritage to the next generation.
text.바스티온의 10년을 집약한 모델, 바스티온 아키타입(Bastion Arc: The Bastion Archetype distills ten years of Bastion into one model and pushes the limits of craftsmanship and performance.
text.아키타입은 10년에 걸친 진화와 정제의 결과입니다. 3D 프린팅 티타늄: The Archetype is the result of ten years of evolution and refinement. It adds wind-tunnel-proven aerodynamics to Bastion's signature construction of 3D-printed titanium lugs and filament-wound carbon tubes. Each one is built to its rider's style and specification, and every detail follows the owner's taste.
text.모든 표면과 접합부를 새로 설계했습니다. 10년 넘는 경험으로 마감을 한: Every surface and junction has been redesigned. More than a decade of experience went into an even finer finish that brings out the natural beauty of the materials. Bastion calls this complexity born from simplicity Ascendant Complexity.
text.슈퍼레제라와 비교해 시속 35km, 0~15° 요각 범위에서: Compared with the Superleggera at 35 km/h and 0–15° of yaw, it is
text.더 빠릅니다. 속도가 오를수록 차이는 커져, 시속 50km에서는 공기저항: faster. The gap grows with speed: at 50 km/h it cuts drag by
Torsional stiffness and power transfer that are unmatched in the industry. Every pedal stroke turns into instant acceleration, driving the rider forward with an efficiency that is hard to believe until you feel it.
text.“우리는 완벽함이 주관적이라고 믿으며, 가장 중요한 것은 당신의 목소리입: “We believe perfection is subjective, and that your voice matters most. The best riding experience comes from a precise balance of technology and craftsmanship.”
text.바스티온 인테그레이티드 포크와 바스템이 프레임과 하나의 선으로 이어집니다: The Bastion integrated fork and bar-stem flow into the frame as one line. All cables are routed internally to reduce frontal area and leave the silhouette of every lug-to-tube joint in plain view.
text.시마노 듀라에이스 Di2, 스램 레드 E1, 캄파놀로 슈퍼레코드 WRL: Choose a Shimano Dura-Ace Di2, SRAM RED E1 or Campagnolo Super Record WRL groupset, and upgrade to the Bastion BC-01 crankset, a power meter and oversized pulleys.
text.피렐리 피제로 벨로 레이스 TLR: Pirelli P Zero Velo Race TLR
text.시마노 듀라에이스 Di2 / 스램 레드 E1 / 캄파놀로 슈퍼레코드 WR: Shimano Dura-Ace Di2 / SRAM RED E1 / Campagnolo Super Record WRL
text.바스티온 크랭크 BC-01, 파워미터, 오버사이즈 풀리 외: Bastion BC-01 crankset, power meter, oversized pulleys and more
Ten years ago, Bastion became the first in the world to put 3D-printed titanium lugs on a bicycle. Each set is printed to the rider's geometry, then CNC-machined and polished by hand.
text.카본 튜브는 섬유 방향을 정밀하게 정렬하는 필라멘트 와인딩 공법으로 직접: The carbon tubes are made in-house by filament winding, which aligns every fiber with precision. That is how stiffness, weight and ride quality can be tuned tube by tube.
text.보증금을 지불하면 소유의 상징인 맞춤형 아뮬렛을 받습니다. 아뮬렛으로 디: Your deposit brings a personalized Amulet, the symbol of ownership. With it you enter the design portal and finalize your Bastion with the expert team.
text.모든 바스티온은 같은 철학으로 만들어집니다. 3D 프린팅 티타늄 러그와: Every Bastion is built on the same philosophy: 3D-printed titanium lugs, carbon tubes made in-house, and geometry fitted to the owner's body and riding style. What changes from model to model is where it rides and how it feels.
text.10년의 진화를 집약한 에어로 로드. 바스티온 라인업에서 가장 빠른 모델: An aero road bike that distills ten years of evolution. The fastest model in the Bastion lineup.
text.바스티온을 상징하는 디자인 아이콘. 얇은 다운튜브와 러그로 로드 모델보다: The design icon that defines Bastion. A slimmer down tube and lugs make it about 80–100 g lighter than the road model.
text.아키타입의 NACA 에어로 프로파일을 그래블로 옮긴 플랫폼. 50mm 타: The Archetype's NACA aero profiles brought to gravel. 50 mm tire clearance, electronic 1x only, UDH dropout.
text.700×43C 타이어 클리어런스와 드롭 다운 체인스테이. GRX, 스램: 700×43C tire clearance and a dropped drive-side chainstay. Compatible with 1x and 2x wide drivetrains such as GRX and SRAM WIDE.
text.세계 최초의 티타늄 항공기 A-12 ArchAngel에서 영감을 받은 모: Inspired by the A-12 ArchAngel, the world's first titanium aircraft. Only 88 will be built worldwide.
text.바스티온은 자전거를 선택한 라이더가 그 자전거를 설계할 최고의 사람이라고: Bastion believes the rider who chooses a Bastion is the best person to design it. Every Bastion begins with a personal consultation that takes in your preferences, riding style and body measurements. It is then made with you and for you, in a process that combines advanced technology with traditional craftsmanship.
text.보증금을 지불하면 맞춤형 아뮬렛과 함께 디자인 포털 접근 권한이 주어집니: Your deposit brings a personalized Amulet and access to the design portal.
text.100만 가지 이상의 컬러 조합과 부품을 고르고, 3D 모델과 엔지니어링: Choose from over a million color combinations and components, then approve the 3D model and engineering report.
text.러그의 3D 프린팅과 CNC 가공, 카본 튜브 제작이 멜버른 공장에서 진: The lugs are 3D-printed and CNC-machined and the carbon tubes are made at the factory in Melbourne.
Polishing, paint and dropout engraving complete your Bastion.
text.디자인 포털에서 실시간 렌더링: Real-time rendering in the design portal
text.오너 전용 앱으로 제작 과정 확인: Follow the build in the owners' app
text.소유의 상징, 바스티온 아뮬렛: The Bastion Amulet, a symbol of ownership
text.호주 멜버른 바스티온 공장: The Bastion factory in Melbourne, Australia
text.컬러와 마감, 부품, 드롭아웃에 새긴 이름까지 같은 바스티온은 두 대가: From color and finish to components and the name engraved on the dropout, no two Bastions are alike. Meet the bikes our owners have taken home through Bastion Cycles Korea.
text.오너 바스티온 크로스로드 컬러 페인트: Owner's Bastion Crossroad in custom paint
text.바스티온 로고 다운튜브: Bastion logo on the down tube
text.바스티온 전 라인업을 직접 만나는 곳: See the full Bastion lineup in person.
text.바스티온 쇼룸은 바스티온 사이클의 전 라인업을 직접 보고 만질 수 있는: The Bastion showroom is where you can see and touch the entire Bastion Cycles lineup. Examine the 3D-printed lugs, carbon tubes and color samples, and plan your own Bastion with our team.
